versions.subject: rules for APT32
versions.detection:
selection:
    TargetFileName_lc:
        - '*\wwwroot\\*'
        - '*\wmpub\\*'
        - '*\htdocs\\*'
        - '*inetpub*'
    EventID:
        11
filter:
    Image_lc:
        - '*explorer.exe'
blank:
    Image: null
condition: selection and not filter and not blank
versions.spl: TargetFileName_lc IN ("*\\wwwroot\\*", "*\\wmpub\\*", "*\\htdocs\\*", "*inetpub*") EventID=11 NOT Image_lc="*explorer.exe" NOT NOT Image=*
